name: Anyarin Terathananpat
bio: Anyarin Terathananpat, nicknamed Tubtim, is an actor, model, TV host, and figure skater. She attended ABAC University (Faculty of Business), Ramkhamhaeng University (Faculty of Humanities) and Lyceum of the Philippines University (Doctor of Philosophy in Management).
